## ai

```text
ai [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

Unified AI CLI for Claude, Gemini, Pi, and Codex.

| Short | Long | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-V` | `--version` |  | Show version and exit |
| `-j` | `--json` |  | Print restart results as JSON |
| `-E` | `--event-completion` |  | Return a JSON launch receipt without waiting for replacement registration (requires -X) |
| `-Y` | `--restart-check` | `TEXT` | Check restart gates without acting; optional target |
| `-X` | `--restart-session` | `TEXT` | Restart one idle managed session; optional title, UUID or tmux name |
| `-h` | `--help` |  | Show this message and exit. |

## ai adopt-session

```text
ai adopt-session [OPTIONS] [NAME]
```

Register a Claude Code session started outside `ai` so `ai c <n>` resumes it.

To rename a session already in an `ai` slot, use `ai migrate-session`.

Arguments:

- `[NAME]`

| Short | Long | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-s` | `--source` | `DIRECTORY` | Project root the session ran in (default: the repo root) |
| `-r` | `--repo` | `DIRECTORY` | Repo root that owns .worktrees/ (default: detected from the current directory) |
| `-c` | `--on-collision` | `[gate\|retitle]` | Duplicate-title handling: gate (stop for a human) or retitle (apply a human-supplied title) |
| `-T` | `--new-title` | `TEXT` | With -c retitle: the confirmed new title |
| `-I` | `--new-index` | `INTEGER` | With -c retitle: the confirmed new index |
| `-N` | `--task-namespace` | `TEXT` | Source CC task namespace (default: derived from the UUID) |
| `-t` | `--transcript` | `FILE` | Adopt this transcript file, for a session whose source directory no longer exists |
| `-a` | `--all` |  | Bulk mode: adopt every titled session in the source |
| `-n` | `--dry-run` |  | Show what would happen without writing anything |
| `-y` | `--yes` |  | Skip the confirmation prompt (never covers a title collision) |
| `-m` | `--name` | `TEXT` | Adopt into a slot named with this first name, reserved first |
| `-h` | `--help` |  | Show this message and exit. |

## ai audit-sessions

```text
ai audit-sessions [OPTIONS]
```

Survey titled Claude Code sessions fleet-wide and report which `ai c <n>` cannot resume

| Short | Long | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-r` | `--repo` | `DIRECTORY` | Report only sessions owned by this repo root (default: every repo found) |
| `-t` | `--title` | `TEXT` | Report only the session with this exact title |
| `-a` | `--adopt` |  | Adopt every session that is safe to adopt |
| `-n` | `--dry-run` |  | With -a: show what would be adopted without writing anything |
| `-y` | `--yes` |  | Skip the confirmation prompt (never covers a title collision) |
| `-h` | `--help` |  | Show this message and exit. |

## ai c

```text
ai c [OPTIONS] [NAME]
```

Launch a Claude Code session. A migration to the session's name that this host recorded and never finished is finished first, as `ai migrate-session OLD NEW --finish -y` would, and one recorded finished is re-planned. If any is still partial, the launch is refused: it starts nothing, prints the parts left and the --finish command, and exits 1. -P/--allow-partial-migration starts the session anyway.

Arguments:

- `[NAME]`

| Short | Long | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-p` | `--project` | `TEXT` | Project to open on remote server (directory name, e.g. 'myproject', 'webapp') |
| `-m` | `--remote-machine` | `TEXT` | Remote-machine alias to use with -R/--remote |
| `-R` | `--remote` |  | Run session on the default remote machine |
| `-I` | `--no-session-names` |  | Use an index for this launch |
| `-S` | `--session-names` |  | Use a first name for this launch |
| `-u` | `--no-name` |  | With a label, drop the first name |
| `-w` | `--with-name` |  | With a label, keep a first name after it |
| `-N` | `--name` | `TEXT` | Use this first name for the new session |
| `-H` | `--fm-home` | `TEXT` | With -F: chief home directory (default: &lt;[chief_of_staff] homes_dir>/&lt;machine-key>) |
| `-k` | `--machine-key` | `TEXT` | With -F: machine key naming the chief home (default: $AI_MACHINE_ID) |
| `-F` | `--chief` |  | Launch as the chief-of-staff session (one per machine; with -R, on the remote machine) |
| `-P` | `--allow-partial-migration` |  | Start the session even though a recorded migration to its name is partial; the parts left are written into the launch log |
| `-d` | `--dry-run` |  | Print the resolved launch plan and exit; creates and starts nothing |
| `-v` | `--verbose` |  | Show additional launch progress details |
| `-q` | `--quiet` |  | Suppress launch progress output |
| `-D` | `--no-direnv` |  | Skip the direnv preflight and auto-install |
| `-W` | `--no-worktree` |  | Disable git worktree isolation |
| `-s` | `--sandbox` |  | Enable sandboxing (default: off) |
| `-n` | `--notify` |  | Fire system notifications on task completion |
| `-b` | `--bare` |  | Run bare tool without tmux at all |
| `-o` | `--once` |  | Run once without tmux auto-resume loop |
| `-r` | `--resume` |  | Resume an existing session |
| `-j` | `--json` |  | Print restart results as JSON |
| `-E` | `--event-completion` |  | Return a JSON launch receipt without waiting for replacement registration (requires -X) |
| `-Y` | `--restart-check` | `TEXT` | Check restart gates without acting; optional target |
| `-X` | `--restart-session` | `TEXT` | Restart one idle managed session; optional title, UUID or tmux name |
| `-h` | `--help` |  | Show this message and exit. |

## ai cos

```text
ai cos [OPTIONS] [NAME]
```

Attach to, resume or launch this machine's chief-of-staff Claude Code session, here or with -R on a remote machine (`ai c --chief`). Needs the [chief_of_staff] settings in config.toml, whose command_aliases and flag_aliases add synonyms for `cos` and `--chief`

Arguments:

- `[NAME]`

| Short | Long | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-p` | `--project` | `TEXT` | Project to open on remote server (directory name, e.g. 'myproject', 'webapp') |
| `-m` | `--remote-machine` | `TEXT` | Remote-machine alias to use with -R/--remote |
| `-R` | `--remote` |  | Run session on the default remote machine |
| `-I` | `--no-session-names` |  | Use an index for this launch |
| `-S` | `--session-names` |  | Use a first name for this launch |
| `-u` | `--no-name` |  | With a label, drop the first name |
| `-w` | `--with-name` |  | With a label, keep a first name after it |
| `-N` | `--name` | `TEXT` | Use this first name for the new session |
| `-H` | `--fm-home` | `TEXT` | With -F: chief home directory (default: &lt;[chief_of_staff] homes_dir>/&lt;machine-key>) |
| `-k` | `--machine-key` | `TEXT` | With -F: machine key naming the chief home (default: $AI_MACHINE_ID) |
| `-F` | `--chief` |  | Launch as the chief-of-staff session (one per machine; with -R, on the remote machine) |
| `-P` | `--allow-partial-migration` |  | Start the session even though a recorded migration to its name is partial; the parts left are written into the launch log |
| `-d` | `--dry-run` |  | Print the resolved launch plan and exit; creates and starts nothing |
| `-v` | `--verbose` |  | Show additional launch progress details |
| `-q` | `--quiet` |  | Suppress launch progress output |
| `-D` | `--no-direnv` |  | Skip the direnv preflight and auto-install |
| `-W` | `--no-worktree` |  | Disable git worktree isolation |
| `-s` | `--sandbox` |  | Enable sandboxing (default: off) |
| `-n` | `--notify` |  | Fire system notifications on task completion |
| `-b` | `--bare` |  | Run bare tool without tmux at all |
| `-o` | `--once` |  | Run once without tmux auto-resume loop |
| `-r` | `--resume` |  | Resume an existing session |
| `-h` | `--help` |  | Show this message and exit. |

## ai migrate-session

```text
ai migrate-session [OPTIONS] [OLD] [NEW]
```

Rename a session already registered in an `ai` slot.

Afterwards it cleans up the old name in every other repo: a clean, landed `.worktrees/OLD` slot is retired (tips anchored, checkout removed) and an empty `OLD-agents` container removed; anything kept is named with its reason and the command exits 1. On a repo whose OLD slot is such a leftover, it does only that cleanup, even while NEW is live elsewhere.

Every Beads issue assigned to exactly OLD and not closed, in each store under the projects dir, is re-keyed to NEW with `bd --actor OLD update --if-assignee OLD` and a comment; a store bd cannot read is named and the command exits 1, and each changed store is named as needing its publish step. With --finish it re-keys only when this host records that OLD was migrated to NEW; --beads-only does just that re-key, and runs while NEW is live.

--finish given one name (OLD, NEW or NEW's first name, positionally or with -t) finds the pair and its repo in this host's migration record, from any directory; a name matching no pair, or several, is refused with exit 2 and what it matched.

Every writing run ends with a read-only re-plan of the pair. Only a re-plan that finds nothing left records the migration finished (verified); otherwise the run names each part left as NOT finished and exits 1. A hook is done only when its --dry-run prints `migrate-status: done`.

-s/--status [NAME] lists, read-only, each migration this host records that is not verified finished (-a/--all: every one), re-planned as complete or partial with the parts left and the --finish command; NAME narrows it to one pair. It runs while NEW is live, writes nothing, and exits 1 if any pair is partial, 2 on a usage error. -R/--remote runs it on the default remote machine.

With -t/--to-name [NAME], reserve a first name (NAME, or the shortest free one) and migrate OLD to it; with -a/--all -T/--to-names, list every index-named session of the repo on this host, and with -y migrate each stopped one. -L/--max-length N picks names of at most N letters, within the configured limits; -O/--over-limit selects this host's sessions whose name is longer than max_name_length.

For a session started outside `ai`, use `ai adopt-session`.

Arguments:

- `[OLD]`
- `[NEW]`

| Short | Long | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-r` | `--repo` | `DIRECTORY` | Repo root that owns .worktrees/ (default: detected from the current directory) |
| `-n` | `--dry-run` |  | Print every planned move without writing anything |
| `-y` | `--yes` |  | Skip the confirmation prompt |
| `-f` | `--finish` |  | The slot already moved to NEW: carry or clean up every leftover still named OLD, hooks included; with -n/--dry-run it plans even while a session is live and names it |
| `-b` | `--beads-only` |  | Only re-key the Beads issues still on OLD, for a migration this host records; NEW may be running |
| `-t` | `--to-name` | `TEXT` | Reserve a first name (this one, or the shortest free one) and migrate OLD to it |
| `-s` | `--status` |  | List each recorded migration not verified finished as complete or partial, read-only |
| `-R` | `--remote` |  | With -s/--status: run it on the default remote machine |
| `-a` | `--all` |  | With -T/--to-names: every index-named session here; with -s/--status: every recorded migration |
| `-T` | `--to-names` |  | With -a/--all: migrate each one to a picked first name |
| `-L` | `--max-length` | `INTEGER` | Pick names of at most this many letters |
| `-O` | `--over-limit` |  | With -a -T: only names longer than max_name_length |
| `-h` | `--help` |  | Show this message and exit. |

## ai sessions relaunch

```text
ai sessions relaunch [OPTIONS] [SLUG]
```

Relaunch recorded sessions detached, without a terminal application.

A session whose recorded migration is partial is refused, with the parts left and the command that finishes it; the others still relaunch, and the command exits 1.

Arguments:

- `[SLUG]`

| Short | Long | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-b` | `--boot` |  | Replay eligible owning-host sessions after boot |
| `-d` | `--dry-run` |  | Print decisions without writing or launching |
| `-P` | `--allow-partial-migration` |  | Relaunch a session even though a recorded migration to its name is partial; the parts left are written into its launch log |
| `-h` | `--help` |  | Show this message and exit. |

## ai sessions stop

```text
ai sessions stop [OPTIONS] NAME
```

Stop a managed session so its wrapper does not relaunch the agent

Arguments:

- `NAME`

| Short | Long | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-t` | `--timeout` | `FLOAT RANGE` | Seconds to wait for the session to exit  [default: 30.0; x>=0] |
| `-h` | `--help` |  | Show this message and exit. |

## ai sessions wind-down

```text
ai sessions wind-down [OPTIONS] SLUG
```

Stop a running session for a maintenance window, recording maintenance_wind_down so the boot relaunch or a named relaunch brings it back

Arguments:

- `SLUG`

| Short | Long | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-t` | `--timeout` | `FLOAT RANGE` | Seconds to wait for the session to exit  [default: 30.0; x>=0] |
| `-d` | `--dry-run` |  | Check the session and print the plan without writing or stopping |
| `-h` | `--help` |  | Show this message and exit. |
